intro: These terms and conditions apply when you use our website and our immigration advice services.
body: Our service: we give immigration advice and help you prepare applications. UK Immigration Advisory is a trading name of Unique Visa Services Ltd, regulated by the Immigration Advice Authority, reference F200700144. We are not a law firm and are not connected to the Home Office.
Client care letter: before we start work, we send you a client care letter setting out the work we’ll do, our fee and how to complain. That letter forms part of our agreement.
Decisions: all immigration decisions are made by the Home Office. We can’t guarantee the outcome of any application.
Your responsibilities: give us complete and truthful information and genuine documents, and tell us about anything that could affect your case.
Fees: our fee is agreed in writing before we start. Home Office fees and the Immigration Health Surcharge are paid separately.
These terms are governed by the law of England and Wales.

sections.heading: Questions about these terms and conditions
sections.text: Contact us before you instruct us if anything in these terms and conditions is unclear.

faqs.q: Do your terms and conditions guarantee a visa?
